user_authority: Continued research is already authorized; coordinator adoption and independent review remain pending.
rules: Prospective IDs do not identify completed experiments.
implementation_links, run_artifacts and outcomes stay empty until real artifacts are produced and verified.
Literature motivates design choices; thresholds are analyst choices and numerical reference is not physical truth.

entries.question: Do retained diagnostic windows expose integrity, domain, finite-jump, or controller branch obstructions before fresh coupled runs?
planned_inputs: Original dense s840131-p1-a4 and s840137-p1-a4 full17 arrays
Corresponding event hashes and source freeze
observables: Signed geometric margins and conservative finite-jump risk brackets
Control command hashes and branch signatures
entries.failure_outcome: Stop and retain exact offending inputs; do not infer an exact crossing time.

entries.question: Does the same on-manifold model with a documented geometry extension pass the joint-stage self-consistency screen?
observables: Max common-endpoint position, velocity, attitude, body-rate differences
entries.acceptance_origin: PLAN.md section 7; all numerical caps and 0.6 factor are analyst-designed.

entries.step: Held-input physics and source bridge checks
entries.question: Are the new finest-hold differences dominated by hold cadence rather than unresolved held-ODE integration or changed baseline semantics?
entries.acceptance_origin: PLAN.md section 7; no two-level order estimate.

entries.question: Does the held-input family approach J3 under the unchanged sampled controller within prescribed numerical screens?
observables: All gate outcomes and nonmonotonic cases
Controller branch differences and finite-jump risk traces
entries.acceptance_origin: PLAN.md section 7; original four absolute caps, prospective 0.7 reduction screen, no Richardson/truth-error bound.

entries.question: What work and measured resource cost accompanies each completed numerical comparison?
observables: Whole-swarm field evaluations and rotor kernels
Vehicle derivative evaluations and controller updates
Separated field/controller/RK/safety/recording and total job times
entries.claim_limit: One-off instrumented CPU costs, not a browser speedup or established frontier.

entries.question: Are numerical conclusions explicitly conditional on the frozen, unvalidated receiver/superposition model?
entries.required_statement: A numerical reference is not physical truth; no safe-flight, full-mission, novelty or 5000-drone browser feasibility claim.
